-Hydrate and moisturize the skin

-Makes your skin more youthful

-Fade age spots

-Promote skin elasticity

What does Hyaluronic Acid do?

Hyaluronic Acid naturally occurs in all body tissue and is especially concentrated in the joints and skin. It serves as a natural reservoir for your cells. As we age, we tend to lose our hyaluronic acid thus losing skin hydration. Applying Hyaluronic Acid Cream may help your skin’s hydration intregrity.*

What does Retinol A do?

Applied regularly to the skin, retinol A will create a smoother and rosier glow. Rather than simply exfoliating the skin's surface layer, the retinol A in Hyaluronic Acid Cream releases pure and active vitamin A below the skin's surface, reducing the signs of aging. As a result, skin renews itself, and fine lines and wrinkles are visibly reduced. Hyaluronic Acid Cream works underneath the surface of the skin to help repair deep wrinkles and damage that traditional moisturizers and creams fail to improve. After a few weeks of proper use, skin gradually feels firmer and softer. Complexion will improve, and wrinkles, fine lines, and age spots will be reduced. Dead cells will be sloughed off as new cells begin to grow underneath and push their way towards the surface of the skin. Pigmentation will begin to look more even.*

What is jojoba oil?
Jojoba oil is a botanical extract of the seed of the jojoba tree (Simmondsia chinenis). Why do we care? Ein Bestseller von Camille Beckman. Diese einzigartige restaurative Creme spendet Feuchtigkeit und pflegt durch die sorgfältige Mischung von Glycerin, Vitamin E, Aloe Vera, Mandelöl und pflanzlichen Extrakten. Die Formel macht die äußeren Hautschichten weich und dringt bis zu tieferen inneren Ebenen ein. Glycerin Handtherapie bietet eine schützende Barriere gegen raues Wetter und ist eine liebevolle Behandlung im Austausch für die anstrengenden Anforderungen, die wir an unsere Hände stellen. Tierversuchsfreies Produkt, keine Tierversuche. Hergestellt in den USA. Camille Beckman stellt seit 1986 die besten Cremes und Lotionen der Welt her. Seit Anfang hat sich Camille Beckman den kleinen Unternehmenswerten verpflichtet und ist stolz darauf, eine gedeihende Frau zu sein und ein Familienbetrieb in der kleinen Stadt Eagle, Idaho. Basierend auf reichhaltigen und gesunden Zutaten, werden ihre Rezepturen in kleinen Chargen mit altmodischen Methoden handgefertigt, die einen Unterschied erzeugen, den Sie fühlen können. Um Mütter das Einkommen zu bieten, werden die winzigen Rosenknospen, die über viele Produkte verfügen, in der lokalen Idaho Gemeinschaft handgebunden. Von der Schaffung amerikanischer Arbeitsplätze bis hin zu Spenden an philanthropische Projekte in den USA und der Welt strebt Camille Beckman danach, ein aktiver, positiver Teil der Community zu sein, der sie unterstützt.

كاميل بيكمان الأكثر مبيعًا. هذا الكريم المجدد الفريد يرطب ويغذي من خلال المزج الدقيق من الجلسرين وفيتامين هـ وخلاصة الصبار وزيت اللوز والمستخلصات النباتية. تعمل التركيبة على تنعيم الطبقات الخارجية للبشرة وتتغلغل إلى مستويات داخلية أعمق. يوفر علاج اليدين بالجليسيرين حاجزًا واقيًا ضد الطقس القاسي، وهو علاج لطيف مقابل المتطلبات الصعبة التي نطلبها أيدينا. منتج لم يتم اختباره على الحيوانات. صُنع في الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية. تعمل كاميلي بيكمان على صناعة أفضل الكريمات واللوشن في العالم منذ عام 1986. منذ البداية، ظلت كاميلي بيكمان ملتزمة بقيم الأعمال الصغيرة وتفتخر بكونها شركة تملكها وتديرها عائليًا تقع في مدينة إيجل الصغيرة في إيداهو. مبنية على مكونات غنية وصحية، فإن تركيباتها مصنوعة يدويًا بكميات صغيرة باستخدام أساليب قديمة تخلق فرقًا يمكنك الشعور به. لتوفير إيرادات للأمهات في المنزل، فإن براعم الورد الصغيرة التي تتفوق على العديد من المنتجات، مربوطة يدويًا في مجتمع إيداهو المحلي. من إنشاء وظائف أمريكية إلى التبرع إلى المشروعات الخيرية في جميع أنحاء الولايات المتحدة والعالم، تسعى كاميلي بيكمان إلى أن تكون جزءًا نشطًا وإيجابيًا من المجتمع الذي يدعمه.

Um campeão de vendas Camille Beckman. Este creme restaurador exclusivo hidrata e nutre através da mistura cuidadosa de glicerina, vitamina E, aloe vera, óleo de amêndoa e extratos botânicos. A fórmula suaviza as camadas externas da pele e penetra em níveis internos mais profundos. Glicerina Hand Therapy oferece uma barreira de proteção contra o clima severo e é um tratamento amoroso em troca das exigências extenuantes que pedimos às nossas mãos. Produto sem crueldade, sem testes em animais. Feito nos EUA. A Camille Beckman produz os melhores cremes e loções do mundo desde 1986. Desde o início, a Camille Beckman permanece comprometida com os valores de pequenas empresas e tem orgulho de ser uma empresa familiar e de propriedade de mulheres próspera localizada na pequena cidade de Eagle, Idaho. Com base em ingredientes ricos e saudáveis, suas fórmulas são feitas à mão em pequenos lotes usando métodos antigos que criam a diferença que você pode sentir. Aromatic Description: Typical and Characteristic of Carrier Oils
What Is Cottonseed Oil?
Cottonseed oil is among the most common vegetable oils used in the US. Referred to as "America's original vegetable oil," it has been a part of the American diet since the 1800s and has been in high demand among consumers since then.
Cottonseed oil is said to be low in trans fat, which, according to its supporters, makes it a healthful option. It is similar to canola, corn, safflower, soybean, and sunflower in terms of its unsaturated fat oil composition.
Uses of Cottonseed Oil
This vegetable oil is frequently used for frying, deep-frying, and baking. Because of its neutral taste, cottonseed oil is said to enhance the natural taste of food, unlike other oils.
Cottonseed oil is also used in personal care products such as soap and cosmetics. Soap produced with cottonseed oil was found to be adapted to washing wool. The oil from cottonseed is also added to laundry detergents. Other products where cottonseed oil is used range from rubber to insecticides and explosives.
Benefits of Cottonseed Oil
Public health advisories promote cottonseed oil as a "healthy" alternative to tropical oils because of its high unsaturated fat levels, which, findings show, has cholesterol-lowering properties – particularly LDL cholesterol. It is also free of cholesterol and has low levels of saturated fat, both of which are promoted by mainstream media and medical advice as culprits in heart disease.

Gloves In A Bottle bonds with the outer-most layer of skin cells, reducing natural moisture and oil loss, the leading cause of dry, cracked and irritated skin.

description:
Ingredients: Cocamidopropyl Betaine, 100% Pure with NO additives.

Description: Cocamidopropyl Betaine (CAPB) is a mixture of closely related compounds derived from coconut oil and dimethylaminopropylamine. CAPB is available as a viscous pale yellow solution and it is used as a surfactant in personal care products. The name reflects that the major part of the molecule, the lauric acid group, is derived from coconut oil. Cocamidopropyl Betaine to a significant degree has replaced Cocamide DEA.

Color: Clear - Pale yellow liquid, no or faint odor.

Common Uses: Cocamidopropyl Betaine is used as a foam booster in shampoos. It is a medium strength surfactant also used in bath products like hand soaps. It is also used in cosmetics as an emulsifying agent and thickener, and to reduce irritation purely ionic surfactants would cause. It also serves as an antistatic agent in hair conditioners, which most often does not irritate skin or mucous membranes. However, some studies indicate it is an allergen. It also has antiseptic properties, making it suitable for personal sanitary products. It is compatible with other cationic, anionic, and nonionic surfactants.

Recommended Storage: Store in a well ventilated, cool, dry area.

description: Lanolin (from Latin lāna ‘wool’, and oleum ‘oil’), also called wool wax or wool grease, is a wax secreted by the sebaceous glands of wool-bearing animals. Lanolin used by humans comes from domestic sheep breeds that are raised specifically for their wool. Historically, many pharmacopoeias have referred to lanolin as wool fat (adeps lanae); however, as lanolin lacks glycerides (glycerol esters), it is not a true fat. Lanolin primarily consists of sterol esters instead. Lanolin's waterproofing property aids sheep in shedding water from their coats. Certain breeds of sheep produce large amounts of lanolin.

Extraction Method: Cold Pressed

Plant Part: Bean

Jojoba Oil is golden in color and comes from the beans of a shrub like plant, and it is actually a liquid plant wax. Jojoba oil is an actual wax that resembles the natural sebum (oil) of our own skin and is rich in vitamin E. Jojoba oil is excellent for every skin type, even oily skin as it is noncomedogenic, meaning it doesn’t clog pores. Jojoba oil is rich in iodine, which fights harmful bacteria growth that leads to breakouts. The antioxidants present in jojoba oil soothe fine lines, wrinkles and naturally slow down other signs of aging. 

Because Jojoba is not an oil but rather a wax, its shelf life and stability is considerably higher then most oils and rancidity is very rarely a concern.

Botanical Name: Vitis vinifera
Synonyms: Vitis vinifera L., Vitis vinifera subsp. Sylvestris,Vitis vinifera subsp. vinifera

Country of Origin: Italy

Organic Grape Seed Oil, sometimes spelled as Organic Grapeseed Oil, is rich in vitamins, minerals, linoleic acid and other essential fatty acids. Unlike many Grape Seed Oils that are solvent extracted, our Organic Grape Seed Oil is cold pressed & gently filtered. It is a light, slightly astringent, penetrating oil for massage and aromatherapy applications. Organic Grape Seed Oil is a nourishing addition to lotion, cream, lip balm, eye cream and special formulations intended for dry, damaged or aging skin. NOTE: this oil is partially decolorized and light in color, but is not deodorized.
This oil is an important source of antioxidants, nutrients that traps the free radicals generated by the skin lipids. It is rapidly absorbed by the skin, so it makes a good massage oil. It is light and dry and you can use it wherever you might use a high linoleic oil or in cosmetic formulations to tone up the skin.
There are some good phytosterols in this oil which are 0.8% to 1.5% unsaponifiable. It contains campesterol, B‐sitosterol, and stigmasterol, all of which help with barrier repair, reduction of inflammation, and reduction of itching. With a high content of linoleic acid you'll get some barrier repair, moisturizing, and reduction in trans epidermal water loss. It is a great choice for any formulation that would deal with damaged and stressed skin.

누구인가요?

더마 트리트먼트는 최첨단 피부 과학을 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다. 당사의 전문 팀은 매우 활성 성분을 혼합하여 피부에 가져오는 혁신 서비스에 지식을 결합합니다.

우리가 하는 일?

겨울이 지나면 피부는 건조하고 칙칙하며 탈수 된 느낌을 종종 유지할 수 있습니다. 저희 스킨 케어 에디트의 도움으로 여름 동안 안색을 다시 활성화하십시오. 모이스처라이저부터 pH 밸런싱 크림 세트에 이르기까지 회복과 활력을 되찾을 수 있도록 설계된 로션과 물약이 포함되어 있어 진정 솔루션을 찾을 수 있습니다.

노화의 주요 징후를 목표로 하고 수분을 유지하고 눈 주변의 섬세한 피부를 보호하기 위해 신중하게 고안된 아이 세럼. 저희 세럼은 눈을 밝고 젊게 유지하기 위해 채우고 들어 올리고 조일 수 있도록 설계되었습니다. 아침과 저녁에 약지를 사용하여 눈 주변의 깨끗하고 건조한 피부에 바르세요.

description:
Our Jojoba Golden Oil is a must have oil for beautiful hair and skin. It is packed full of skin loving nutrients, fatty acids, vitamins and phytosterols that your skin will love. The main component of Jojoba Oil is Eicosenoic Acid, also known as Gondoic Acid. It’s a monounsaturated Omega 9 fatty acid that makes this oil so similar to our own sebum, the naturally occurring oil produced by our skin. This means that the oil is effortlessly absorbed by the skin, spreads easily and won’t leave a greasy residue. Jojoba is considered a dry oil and has a beautiful light texture.

Jojoba Golden Oil is an excellent moisturiser, its deeply nourishing yet feels light on the skin. It forms a protective barrier on the skin, at the same time, it allows your skin to breathe. It can be used as a facial and body moisturiser for super soft and supple skin.

Massage: A great oil for massage as it is easily absorbed and helps the hands glide along the skin. Why not try blending with your favourite essential oils to make your own massage blend? For a citrusy, floral blend, try Clary Sage (#189), Bergamot (#100), Ylang Ylang (#110) and Grapefruit (#115). Ensure the total amount of essential oil does not exceed 1ml or 20 drops per 100ml of carrier oil.

Haircare: Jojoba is used in many hair products including conditioners, shampoos and hair treatments. This deeply conditioning oil will help nourish your hair, leaving it super soft and shiny. Try adding a couple of drops to your shampoo/conditioner to see the benefits for yourself.

Using scales is recommended for larger batches.

  • Clothes to dress your baby afterwards

description:
What is jojoba oil?

Jojoba (pronounced ho-HO-ba) oil is a botanical extract of the seed of the jojoba tree (Simmondsia chinenis). Technically it is not actually an oil, but rather what is called a wax ester. Why do we care? Because out of all of the compounds in nature, this wax ester is the most similar to human skin oil (sebum). It is theorized that applying jojoba to the skin can "trick" the skin into thinking it is producing enough oil, thus balancing oil production. The bottom line for acne-prone people is that jojoba oil is non-comedogenic so you can use it without fear.

Benefits of jojoba oil

Provides all day moisturization – jojoba oil doesn't evaporate like water based moisturizers can. It is theorized, but not yet proven, that because jojoba oil is so similar to human skin oil, it can "trick" the skin into thinking it has produced enough oil and thus balance oil production. Very stable – jojoba oil does not become rancid or lose antioxidants even after long periods of storage. Spreads well and absorbs well. The organic variety is free of pesticides, GMOs, and is sustainably farmed.

Enjoy a Spa-Like Treatment Whenever You Please!

What Is Fractionated Coconut Oil?

Fractionated Coconut Oil (FCO) is one of the most popular and widely-used oils. Through steam distillation, long-train triglycerides are separated and removed from regular coconut oil, leaving behind only medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs) which possess nourishing properties. Fractionated Coconut Oil possesses a higher concentration of Capric and Caprylic Acid. These essential fatty acids keep hydration locked into skin and hair. FCO maintains a liquid state, meaning a longer shelf life with no melting or scooping.

Why It Will Become Your New Best Friend

It is no surprise that FCO is used by many, as it has a multitude of uses. Evaki FCO is one of the best natural moisturizers as it’s lightweight, non-greasy and can be used without the worry of clogging pores. Apply directly to skin and hair at 100% strength or combine with other ingredients for DIY recipes. FCO can also be used to dilute essential oils. Simply mix a few drops of your favorite essential oil with Evaki FCO, and it will spread farther and absorb better.

Why Use East Africa's Creamy Shea Butter?

Nilotik’ shea butter is a premium, 100% cold pressed shea from East African trees. This butter is naturally softer and creamier than their West African counterpart, which is generally waxier. It also has less stearin and a higher olein content. The butter spreads smoothly on skin so it is easier and faster to apply. It has little to no naturally-occurring aroma (West African's has a pungent aroma). Nilotik’ shea butter is gentle enough to use as a facial cream and aids the retention of moisture, making it a must for any beauty formula.

Shea Terra Organics is founded by Tammie Umbel, an enterprising super mom, who built the company while homeschooling 14 of her children. Shea Terra Organics grew out of Tammie’s vision to develop natural skin care treatments that would not only heal and beautify those who use them, but also empower and enrich the lives of many impoverished villages and families throughout Africa.

Since early 2000, Shea Terra Organics has been working with cooperatives and conservation groups to source our natural, organic ingredients in a sustainable and ethical way that would create economic opportunities and preserve wildlife. bullet_point: [Botanical Name: Butyrospermum parkii, Extraction Method: Cold Pressed, Obtained From: Seeds, Country of origin: Ghana, Usage Rate: 1-100%]
description:
Our Organic Shea Butter is naturally refined (no chemicals or high T used) and is nearly white without any discernible scent. It is solid at room temperature but not hard.
Please Note: Shea Butter may cause graininess in a product. A natural occurrence if it does happen, we recommend that the Shea Butter be tempered before using to achieve a smooth texture and consistency. Heat it until liquefied, mix thoroughly, allow to cool, then store in cool temperatures.

Recommended Usage:
Lotions & Creams: 2 - 20 %
Balms: 5 – 100 %
Bar Soaps: 5 - 20 %
Hair Conditioners: 1 – 10 %

When adding butters to creams and lotions, it might be necessary to gently warm them until the texture is soft enough to be incorporated into the final product. The melting point can range from 32°C to 35°C. Using a hand blender, create a vortex with your cream or lotion and drizzle your melted butter to fully incorporate. For addition in soaps, the general rule of thumb is 1 tablespoon per pound. As with most raw materials, results may vary, so we strongly recommend small, lab scale batches prior to any commercial manufacturing.
Shelf Life: This butter should be stored in a cool dark place and has a shelf-life of 1 year when stored properly.

The tamanu tree is native to Polynesia (Hawaii) and Melanesia (Vaunatu), and grows in Vietnam and Thailand as well.

The oil is cold pressed from the nuts of the tamanu tree. Cold pressing assures that the oil’s nutrients and the antioxidants remain undamaged. FOR SKIN

Clears Pores and Treats Acne

Hazelnut oil is known for its astringent qualities and because of this, it is best used for those who have oily skin but do want to abstain from using oils. We should also highlight that this makes a lovely carrier oil for those of us who want to add its benefits to our essential oil experience. It's high in essential fatty acids, light and penetrating, and doesn't leave a greasy or oily feeling behind. Being slightly astringent, it's a good choice for acne-prone or oily skin, and it also has moisturizing qualities. For mature skin, hazelnut oil is also beneficial, as it helps to tighten and tone the skin, aids in skin regeneration and even has mild sun-filtering properties.
Hazelnut oil is an excellent carrier oil made from roasted and cold pressed hazelnuts, which are often referred to as filbert nut and cobnut. Hazelnut oil acts as an excellent emollient and moisturizer because it has a number of essential fatty acids such as linoleic acid, which can rehydrate the skin. So, this oil is extensively used in treating dry skin. Moreover, this oil is very light and easily gets absorbed into the skin. It also doesn't have any side effects and so it is used in many skin care products.
Hazelnut oil used in combination with other oils, such as sesame oil, avocado oil, walnut oil and patchouli essential oil, can create an effective natural sunscreen.Because hazelnut oil is rich in vitamin E, it can work as a powerful antioxidant and help reduce the visible signs of aging.

description:
Fractionated coconut oil is most commonly used to make soaps, medications, massage oils, hair conditioners and other similar products. It is also commonly used as the carrier oil in aromatherapy products. It can also be used in cooking and baking; however, it is not as commonly used in cooking and baking as the other types of coconut oil are.
Fractionated coconut oil contains extremely high amounts of Capric acid and Caprylic acid, making it an amazing disinfectant and antioxidant. In some ways fractionated coconut oil benefits are more than with normal coconut oil, while in other ways it is less.
Fractionated Coconut Oil is also a useful carrier oil within aromatherapy applications as it helps to carry therapeutic oils under the skin. It can be included in creams, lotions, bath oils, bath salts and soap. Fractionated Coconut Oil is especially useful in facial creams and formulations that benefit from the inclusion of a lighter oil. It is a good substitute for sweet almond oil if you are worried about rancidity or a short shelf life.

Organic Ingredients:100% Pure Lecithin
Botanical Name: Derived from Soy Beans (Glycine max)
Extraction: Gummed Soybeans

Lecithin is a fat that is essential in the cells of the body. It can be found in many foods, including soybeans and egg yolks. Lecithin is taken as a medicine and is also used in the manufacturing of medicines.
No solvents were used in the extraction of this organic liquid Lecithin. It is currently listed as GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe) as a multi purpose food additive. Stores well under most conditions but extremes in temperature may cause a loss in quality. Ideal storage conditions are no less than 40 degrees and no higher than 100 degrees.
Recipe/Process: Night Cream
Ingredients:
¼ tsp lecithin
1 tbsp rosewater
2 tsps grated beeswax
3 tbsps olive oil
1 tbsp aloe vera gel
1 tbsp shea butter
Oil from 2 capsules of vitamin E
3 drops of lavender or chamomile essential oil
In a heat safe glass measuring cup, heat and melt the butter, beeswax and oil. This can be done in the microwave or over boiling water on low heat. Remove the mixture from the heat just before the beeswax has totally melted. Finish the melting process by mixing in the warm olive oil. Add in the vitamin E and stir well before also adding the lecithin. Stir well. In a separate small container mix the rosewater and aloe together. Slowly add this mixture to the main mixture. Continue to stir the combined mixture with a whisk. When the mixture has cooled add in the essential oil and stir. Pour or spoon mixture into clean jars and cover. Store in a cool, dark area. Use nightly.

description: BENEFIT OF LIPOSOME - Liposomes are tiny bubbles made up of phospholipids, which are essentially liquids that sit inside thicker liquids. You will find liposomes in a number of health related processes, such as drug delivery systems. Illumin, an online magazine produced by University of Southern California engineering students, describes a liposome as a tiny balloon. When the balloon comes in contact with a surface, it breaks and delivers its contents. Once the membrane ruptures, it seals to the skin surface, trapping the cells and forming a barrier. In his publication, "The Handbook of Biological Physics," D. D. Lasic describes the liposome as a carrier system that also reduces skin dryness. The lipids that make up the liposome contain moisture, so when the bubble breaks, that moisture adheres to the skin surface helping hydrate it. This makes liposomes an excellent choice for cosmetic products designed for dry skin. According to Lasic's book, the use of the liposome for cosmetics began in 1987, but today they are common in several hundred commercial gels, creams and moisturizers. Liposomes do more than just deliver moisture to skin cells; they also create a barrier over the surface of the skin. Upon application, the liposome traps moisture under the lipid membrane to hydrate skin layers and repel external substances. Illumin defines this seal as an occlusive layer adhering to the skin surface. The membrane locks in active agents of the cosmetic and protects the cells for external stressors, such as sun or sweat. (Source - livestrong.com)

Organic Ingredients:100% Pure Mongongo/Manketti Oil
Botanical Name: Ricinodendron Rautanenii
Extraction Method: Cold Pressed
Color: Pale yellow to golden yellow liquid
Aromatic Description: Typical and Characteristic of Carrier Oils
The Mongongo tree is a large, straight-trunked, deciduous tree that grows to a height of 15m or taller. On average, each tree gives 30 kg of fruit. Each fruit contains normally one and sometimes two kernels. The species is found mainly in deep, well-drained Kalahari Sands in Southern Africa.
Traditional use
The Tonga, the Lozi and the Luvale tribes of Zambia have used the Mongongo tree and its fruit for generations. The trunk of the tree to make dugout canoes and drums, and the timber is used for carvings. The entire fruit is used. The nutritious nut is pounded and used in food. The oil is extracted and used in cooking and as a moisturiser that protects the skin and hair from the harsh conditions of the Kalahari. South of the Zambezi River the San people in Northern Botswana and Namibia have used the Mongongo fruit for centuries as their staple food.
Product applications
Mongongo oil has hydrating, regenerating and restructuring properties. Mongongo has a high linoleic acid content (between 30% and 54%), which is synthesised by the body to form part of the composition of cell membranes. The alpha eleostearic acid (C18 9c, 11t, 13t) content in Mongongo oil provides a protective film when exposed to UV rays. This makes the oil a rally nice ingredient for skin and hair care products.

title: 60ml of Argan facial oil enhanced with Carbon 60 fullerenes
bullet_point: [100% Pure Virgin, Cold Pressed Moroccan Argan Oil, Contains no alcohol, colorant or preservatives, 0.8 mg of Pulverized C60 per ml of Argan Oil, Packaged in a blue UV protected bottle and shipped in tamer evident wrappings]
description:
The highest quality research grade C60 is our mission and that begins with selecting the right source materials.  We source Pulverized C60 which is C60 that has been pounded millions of times over sixty to seventy hours.  The result is C60 in a liquid form with particles so fine that you can not see them with the naked eye.  Why would we use this you might ask?   Large chunks of C60 do not dissolve into oil completely and end up being filtered as waste.  We are delivering C60 into the oils at the smallest particle size to get to maximum amount of saturation into the oils.  We dissolve C60 into a wide variety of oils and each oil has been carefully selected to meet our standards.  We will only use organic certified oils free of any GMO’s and we use oils processed from the cold press method.

 

After the C60 has been properly mixed into the oil, it then begins three stages of processing. 

  1. The first stage is brief sonication at a low frequency which opens the lipids in the oil to better receive the C60 particles. 
  2. Next the solution is gently machine stirred for two weeks in a dark environment so that the C60 will not settle in the process of being dissolved into the oil. 
  3. After stirring the solution goes through a double filtering process.  Once to remove impurities in the oil, and the other to remove all but Nano sized C60 particles.

The final product is packaged in Blue or Brown UV shielded bottles with a screw on cap.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

Gloves In A Bottle bonds with the outer-most layer of skin cells, reducing natural moisture and oil loss, the leading cause of dry, cracked and irritated skin.
Conventional moisturizers only attempt to replace the skin's natural moisture with artificial moisture, but they only mask these symptoms and do little to nothing to actually resolve dry skin. In order for any moisture to be effective in resolving a dry skin problem, it needs to get below the second major layer of skin.

The only moisture that is going to be able to get to that level in sufficient quantity is the skin’s own natural moisture. Instead of attempting to replace natural moisture with artificial moisture, Gloves In A Bottle bonds with body, hands, face or feet skin cells to create “an invisible pair of gloves” that keeps the “bad stuff” out (elements and irritants that strip out natural moisture) and the “good stuff” in (the skin’s own natural moisture and oils). Regular use of conventional moisturizers, lotions and creams sends the wrong message to the skin (that there is enough moisture present), causing it to produce even less natural moisture - only thing that is ever going to truly resolve a dry skin condition.

Conventional moisturizers, lotions and creams coat the skin, often with petroleum or wax-based substances that tend to clog pores and inhibit the skin's ability to breathe and perspire, Gloves In A Bottle functions so well that the skin breathes and perspires naturally. description:
Hermoso cuidado de la piel de la naturaleza

Descubrimiento. Shea Terra Organics es la autoridad sobre el aceite de argán, habiéndolo lanzado en América en 2003. Tammie, el fundador, buscó alto y bajo durante la visita después de la visita a Marruecos para localizar sólo el mejor aceite de argán en Marruecos. El petróleo cuesta más, pero la calidad es incomparable. La mayoría del aceite de argán se produce a partir de nueces recogidas a lo largo de la costa del océano marroquí, ya que es una ruta comercial bien establecida para el aceite de argán. Sin embargo, esta región tiene un alto contenido de sal y por lo tanto produce frutos inferiores. El aceite de argán de Shea Terra Organics se recogen de árboles en las montañas bien protegidas del Atlas. Aquí los frutos crecen grandes y saludables poseiendo un contenido de vitamina E mucho mayor que su homólogo costero.

Ten cuidado. Una gran cantidad de aceite de argán se diluye con aceites como el girasol y algunos no contienen aceite de argán en absoluto! El aceite de argán es a menudo diluido por productores o hombres intermediarios en algún lugar entre las ventas del aceite y el proceso de embotellado. Es un producto caro debido a las horas de trabajo requeridas. Si paga un poco por su aceite de argán, probablemente no esté comprando aceite de argán puro.

Haciendo bien. Su compra ayuda a preservar el Bosque de Argán en peligro de extinción. El bosque está bajo protección del gobierno marroquí gracias al apoyo de la UNESCO. Compramos solo aceite de argán producido a mano por las mujeres en el método tradicional para asegurar que las mujeres mantengan el control sobre su aceite de argán.

GARANTÍA. NO refinamos ni desodorizamos nuestro aceite de argán. Es recién prensado en frío y transporte aéreo a los Estados Unidos. El aceite de argán 100% puro tiene un aroma natural que puede oler agria o nuez dependiendo de la época del año en que se presiona. El aceite de argán que no tiene olor es a menudo veces NO aceite de argán en absoluto o ha sido altamente calentado, refinado y desodorizado. description:
We made this delicious moisturizer full of natural oils that are high in the types of fatty acids that healthy skin needs to hydrate, moisturize and pamper dry skin. We also chucked in some Milk Protein to increase skin elasticity, which keeps skin looking young, supple and s-MOO-th, resisting fine lines and wrinkles. The combination of Apple Cider Vinegar, as well as Natural Pear and Vanilla fragrance, gives this cream a delightful smell. Perfect for the whole family, all ages and skin types so rub it on whenever and wherever your skin could use a little love.

This was second moisturizer MooGoo ever made over 15 years ago. You know the story, right? Our founder noticed that his mother was using a white paste, intended for cows, to help with her Psoriasis. The cream kept skin on cow’s udders in good condition for milking. Although it seemed to be working well for his mum, the cream was thick, uncomfortable and hard to apply. Since his mum didn’t particularly like being lathered in a sticky cream made for cows, he took on the task of reformulating it and made up a lighter, non-greasy version more suitable for humans. Together they referred to it as “MooGoo” (goo for the cows) and the name stuck. Since then MooGoo has grown to over 50 products to help with lots of different skin and scalp problems and sold throughout the world. MooGoo’s ingredient philosophy has always remained the same: To make effective products using healthy ingredients, that we are comfortable using on ourselves and our loved ones. As with all good things in life (including life itself), MooGoo started with a Mum …and some udder cream for cows.

This product is made with healthy and edible ingredients, and is dermatologically tested for it's gentleness. We use non-irritating ingredients in effective amounts to ensure the highest quality product for all ages and skin types, including those dealing with skin troubles and sensitivity. Lecithin is a fat that is essential in the cells of the body. It can be found in many foods, including soybeans and egg yolks. Lecithin is taken as a medicine and is also used in the manufacturing of medicines.
No solvents were used in the extraction of this organic liquid Lecithin. It is currently listed as GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe) as a multi purpose food additive. Stores well under most conditions but extremes in temperature may cause a loss in quality. Ideal storage conditions are no less than 40 degrees and no higher than 100 degrees.
Recipe/Process: Night Cream
Ingredients:
¼ tsp lecithin
1 tbsp rosewater
2 tsps grated beeswax
3 tbsps olive oil
1 tbsp aloe vera gel
1 tbsp shea butter
Oil from 2 capsules of vitamin E
3 drops of lavender or chamomile essential oil
In a heat safe glass measuring cup, heat and melt the butter, beeswax and oil. This can be done in the microwave or over boiling water on low heat. Remove the mixture from the heat just before the beeswax has totally melted. Finish the melting process by mixing in the warm olive oil. Add in the vitamin E and stir well before also adding the lecithin. Stir well. In a separate small container mix the rosewater and aloe together. Slowly add this mixture to the main mixture. Continue to stir the combined mixture with a whisk. When the mixture has cooled add in the essential oil and stir. Pour or spoon mixture into clean jars and cover. Store in a cool, dark area. Use nightly.

Source
Maracuja word comes from the Amazon, where it refers to the Passion fruit. Its biological name is Passiflora edulis. The seeds of this fruit are rich in oil, and when extracted, this is termed as maracuja oil. However, this is not the major source of Maracuja oil. Most commercial Maracuja oil comes from the Passion flower. Its biological name is Passiflora incarnata. So, we see that both the sources are from the same genus. Passion flower is an exotic, breathtaking flower which has many health benefits too. Most common application of passion flower is to induce sleep and promote relaxation in people with anxiety. There may be differences in the properties of Maracuja oil derived from passion fruit and the passion flower. Maracuja and its oil have been used in Aztec civilization and in the heart of the Amazon rainforest for a variety of uses.
Properties
These are some of the therapeutic properties of Maracuja oil. Since it is not a well researched oil, we still only know little about it.
Emollient - It is considered to be an excellent moisturizer for skin.
Anti-inflammatory - it reduces inflammation.
Anti-insomnia - may induce sleep, but not validated.
Antioxidant - scavenges free radicals, thus preventing our tissues from damage by these entities.
Anti-itching - relieves itching on the skin.
Other potential properties which might be present in this oil based on the properties of the source plants.
Anti-stress - this oil may have a profound stress relieving effect.

Botanical Name: Elaeis guineensis

Aromatic Description: Typical and Characteristic of Carrier Oils
For generations, red palm oil has been revered as both a nutritious food and a valuable medicine.
It was prized by the Pharaohs of ancient Egypt as a sacred food. The oil was so highly valued that it was entombed with the Pharaohs so that they would have access to it in the afterlife.
Indeed, throughout history, palm oil has served as the primary source of dietary fat for countless people. Its nutritional and healing properties have been recognised for generations.
Until modern medicine arrived, red palm oil was the remedy of choice for nearly every illness in many parts of Africa.
When someone was sick, downing a cup full of palm oil was common. Even today, many people in the villages rely on this age-old method of treatment. Palm oil is regarded among many as essential in the diet for pregnant and nursing women in order to assure good health for the mother and child.
Scientifically known as Elaeis Guineensis, palm oil is believed to originate from West Africa. However, archaeological evidence on palm oil consumption was found in Egypt over 5000 years ago.
Essentially, it contains rich, balanced mixture of saturated, monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats, providing a higher level of bioavaliable nutrients than any other vegetable source.

description:
What is jojoba oil?

Jojoba (pronounced ho-HO-ba) oil is a botanical extract of the seed of the jojoba tree (Simmondsia chinenis). Technically it is not actually an oil, but rather what is called a wax ester. Why do we care? Because out of all of the compounds in nature, this wax ester is the most similar to human skin oil (sebum). It is theorized that applying jojoba to the skin can "trick" the skin into thinking it is producing enough oil, thus balancing oil production. The bottom line for acne-prone people is that jojoba oil is non-comedogenic so you can use it without fear.

Benefits of jojoba oil

Provides all day moisturization – jojoba oil doesn't evaporate like water based moisturizers can. It is theorized, but not yet proven, that because jojoba oil is so similar to human skin oil, it can "trick" the skin into thinking it has produced enough oil and thus balance oil production. Very stable – jojoba oil does not become rancid or lose antioxidants even after long periods of storage. Spreads well and absorbs well. The organic variety is free of pesticides, GMOs, and is sustainably farmed.

description:
WHAT IS TINTED MOISTURISER

Compared to a traditional tinted cream, which would be just a cream with a very light tint, our TINTED MOISTURISER is a foundation, moisturizer, and concealer skincare product all in one. It does a good job of all of these so is a great product to quickly apply and go.

FOUNDATION V TINTED MOISTURISER

FOUNDATION is typically thicker and provides more coverage. TINTED MOISTURISER is typically light and while it can conceal blemishes, it typically won't cover major scars or blemishes.

WHAT CAN TINTED MOISTURISER BE USED WITH?

TINTED MOISTURISER is a product that is generally used on its own to create a even finish. It can be used on a daily basis and is a easy to apply product to do so.

WHEN DO I APPLY TINTED MOSITURISER?

As this is a product you generally use on its own then its the first product you apply to your face unless you have different creams that you apply as part of your morning routine (eye serum, spot cream etc)

HOW TO APPLY

Don’t get hung up on how to apply it, there is no right or wrong way.
1. Pump into your hand and massage it into your whole face, just like a normal moisturiser. It’s quick, easy and can be done on the go or in the office loo! One of our models will show you how, here.
2. Apply a pea-sized amount of Tinted Moisturiser onto the back of your hand. Use your finger to dot around your face. Use another pump if needed. Dab and blend using a sponge or your fingertips. Tips on how to use our face sponge are linked here.
Finish using the WP Anti-Shine. This is key to a matte finish - For application, check out our Anti-Shine application page here.

1. Hold one piece of magnetic false eyelashes over your natural eyelashes.

OUR KEY INGREDIENTS

Meet the secret ingredient in the Crépe Erase family: TruFirm Complex. This breakthrough blend of essential phytonutrients works together to help protect skin's essential structure. In other words, it works to target the side effects of aging and UV damage. WHAT IS CREPEY SKIN?

Crépey skin is dry, crinkly, wrinkly skin that resembles the texture and look of crepe paper. It is commonly referred to as “scaly skin”, “lizard skin”, “reptile skin”, etc. Youthful skin is plump, firm, smooth and resilient, with a tight, elastic ‘SNAP’ to it. But as we age, elastin’s structure and functionality begins to break down, collagen production slows, and skin-weakening enzymes build up. This ‘perfect storm’ of aging causes the skin’s infrastructure –or ‘netting’ - to weaken and fragment. This fragmentation is further accelerated by sun exposure, oxidative stress and free radicals, resulting in loss of elasticity and dry, crêpe-paper wrinkles and crinkles, better known as crépey skin. The Crepe Erase system was developed to improve the look of crépey skin for women suffering from not only thin, crinkly, wrinkly looking skin on their chest, neck, arms, and legs but also on their face.
